gateReview: Indian place value: Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands, Ten-thousands, Lakhs, Ten-lakhs, Crores
International: Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands, Ten-thousands, Hundred-thousands, Millions
Roman numerals: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000. No symbol repeated more than 3 times.
Rounding: Look at the digit to the right of the target place. 5 or more → round up.
Negative numbers: Used for temperature, depth below sea level, bank overdrafts.
